summary: Iteration 6 (Peta Sebaran Aset) validated end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass for GET /api/public/catalog/map (baseline count=25, DKI=5, price_drop only >0 drops, keyword=Vario=1, keyword=zzzz=0, category=TANAH filters correctly, all pins have numeric lat/lng). Frontend: map-entry-button on home opens /map; Leaflet iframe renders cluster bubbles (.marker-cluster) and price pins (.price/.price.drop); cluster click zooms and expands (3→8 pins in test); price pin click shows map-selected-card with title/price; map-card-open navigates to /asset/<id> with gallery-expand visible; map-card-fav increments favorites-entry-button badge to 1 on home; map-card-close hides card; /map?keyword=zzzz shows map-empty pill and '0 asset berlokasi'; home filter Provinsi=DKI Jakarta + view-on-map produces subtitle '5 asset berlokasi • DKI Jakarta'; chip-harga-turun + view-on-map produces '5 asset berlokasi' with gold .price.drop markers. Regressions confirmed: login-entry-button (Masuk), favorites-entry-button, map-entry-button all present on home header.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_map: 'kategori' key is used by the frontend Badge fallback; response also includes 'subkategori' (good). Endpoint is coordinate-only via {latitude:{$ne:null},longitude:{$ne:null}} which correctly excludes assets without pins.

map-html.ts uses unpkg CDN for Leaflet + MarkerCluster — the sandboxed iframe (allow-scripts allow-same-origin) loads them successfully in web preview; may be blocked in strict CSP environments (fine for current preview).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Map endpoint is /api/public/catalog/map; only includes published assets with lat/lng non-null. Frontend /map uses HtmlFrame.web (iframe with srcDoc). Leaflet inside iframe needs page.query_selector('iframe').content_frame() then '.leaflet-container', '.marker-cluster', '.price', '.price.drop'. Filter chaining passes via URL params (provinsi, price_drop, keyword, category_id).
